poses.label: Reach
poses.description: Sit with knees slightly bent and reach for the handle without rounding your lower back.

poses.label: Row
poses.description: Drive your elbows back with your chest tall.

poses.label: Finish
poses.description: Pull the handle to your navel and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

poses.label: Return
poses.description: Reach forward under control while keeping your lower back steady.

checks: Bent knees, unrounded back, narrow handle toward the midsection and a controlled forward reach.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
